items.title: Elon Musk set to become world's first trillionaire as SpaceX lists on US stock market
items.description: "SpaceX wants to be able to take you to the moon, take you to Mars, and ultimately beyond," the tech billionaire said at a launch event in Starbase, Texas.

items.title: David Hockney, giant of British art, dies aged 88
items.description: British artist David Hockney, whose paintings of pools shimmering in the Los Angeles sunshine became icons of 20th-century art, has died at the age of 88, his publicist has announced.

items.title: Two dead after Taliban opens fire on dress code violation protest
items.description: The protest followed the arrests of dozens of women for alleged dress code violation in the Afghan city of Herat.

items.title: Senior Labor figures weigh in on BHP strike, cost could be $120m per day
items.description: Federal Resources Minister Madeleine King says workers threatening strike action at the nation's biggest port deserve "every single cent" of what they earn while a peak industry body says they are "letting down everyone".

items.title: Mitre 10 franchisee battles to stop Bunnings opening next door
items.description: A small town retailer is battling it out with Australia's biggest hardware giant in the Federal Court to stop Bunnings from opening up literally next door to his Mitre 10 franchise.

items.title: Ivan Milat suspected in 11 additional murder, missing persons cases
items.description: A parliamentary inquiry has heard a police taskforce identified 11 unsolved homicide and missing persons cases with potential links to Ivan Milat.

items.title: Billionaire says $150m court loss no reason to change approach to native title
items.description: Mining magnate Andrew "Twiggy" Forrest has defended his company's approach to Indigenous agreements after a court ordered the miner to pay $150 million in compensation to the Yindjibarndi people.

items.title: Australian sprinter's death in Thailand came weeks after her 25th birthday
items.description: The brother of Stawell Gift finalist Jemma Stapleton remembers her "bright smile" and expresses gratitude for the outpouring of grief and support.

items.title: One Nation denies Melbourne fundraiser was moved due to protest concerns
items.description: A One Nation fundraiser in Melbourne has been moved after several protest groups vowed to demonstrate outside, according to police.

items.title: World Cup quick hits: Opening ceremony delights, drinks break drama and Haiti's jersey ban
items.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is up and running, launched by a colourful opening ceremony and comprehensive win for Mexico. Here are the quick hits from the opening day of the tournament.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
